en.headline: Firefighters battle hill fire near Tuen Mun residential estates
en.dek: Crews continued fighting a blaze on Por Lo Shan near Shan King Estate on Sunday afternoon, with a Government Flying Service helicopter dropping water and no injuries reported.
body: Hong Kong firefighters were still battling a hill fire near residential areas in Tuen Mun on Sunday afternoon, several hours after the blaze was first reported.

The Fire Services Department said the fire broke out at about 1:30 p.m. in a patch of grass measuring roughly 10 by 20 metres on Por Lo Shan near a freshwater service reservoir off Wong Yin Street. Flames spread along the hillside near Shan King Estate, not far from two secondary schools, sending thick smoke into the air.

Authorities deployed a Government Flying Service helicopter to drop water on the fire. As of 5 p.m., emergency crews remained on the scene. No injuries were reported. The Hong Kong Observatory had issued a Yellow Fire Danger Warning earlier in the day, indicating a high fire risk under dry conditions.

zh.headline: 屯門菠蘿山山火近屋苑 消防直升機灑水撲救
zh.dek: 周日下午屯門菠蘿山近山景邨一帶山火持續，消防處調派政府飛行服務隊直升機灑水協助，暫無人員受傷報告。
body: 屯門周日下午發生山火，消防人員持續撲救，事件近山景邨等住宅區。
消防處表示，火警於下午約1時30分發生，地點在黃燕街對出淡水配水庫附近的菠蘿山草坡，面積約10米乘20米。火焰沿山坡蔓延，靠近山景邨，並接近兩所中學，濃煙升空。
政府飛行服務隊直升機到場灑水協助。截至下午5時，救護人員仍在現場撲救。暫無人員受傷。天文台較早已發出黃色火災危險警告，表示火災危險性頗高。
